title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Work at Exadel - Who We Are:

Since 1998, Exadel has been engineering its products and custom software for clients of all sizes. Headquartered in Walnut Creek, California, Exadel has 2,800+ employees in development centers across America, Europe, and Asia. People drive Exadel’s success and are at the core of our values.



*Responsibilities*

Design and implement prioritized backend features using best software engineering practices and consistent functional and technical validations throughout the development lifecycle.

Deliver scalable, flexible, and resilient solutions aligned with modern architectural principles.

Apply and advocate for architectural patterns such as event-driven microservices.

Actively participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the product’s technical architecture.

Support product discussions by providing technical input to guide architecture-related decisions.

Integrate internal and external services using RESTful APIs, asynchronous messaging, and event hubs.


*Requirements:

  • Experience in backend development with Java 8+
  • Experience with Spring Boot
  • Strong experience in developing and deploying microservices in public cloud environments (preferably AWS).
  • Solid knowledge of relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB).
  • Experience with messaging and event streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS).
  • Proficiency with microservices architecture including containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with observability best practices (structured logging, metrics, health checks), using tools like DataDog.
  • Strong testing practices: unit testing (JUnit), integration and contract testing (Postman/Newman).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins or similar.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java com conhecimento em Calypso
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos

Conhecimento Técnico

• Conhecimentos em containers, kubernetes e microserviços;

• Experiencia com Java, Design Patterns e Arquitetura de Microserviços (desejável conhecimento em Quarkus/Mutiny);

• Conhecimentos em diferentes tipos de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc);

• Conhecimentos em tecnologias AWS (EKS, SNS, SQS, S3, DocumentDB, Secret Manager, API Gateway, Lambda);

• Conhecimentos com banco de dados (PostgreSQL, DocumentDB);

• Atividades de manutenção e suporte às soluções de back office utilizando aplicação Calypso;

• Desejável conhecimento de mercado financeiro.


Responsabilidade

• Profissional de TI especializado em Desenvolvimento backend com Java e Calypso, que participa da fase de entendimento de requisitos, desenvolvimento, testes, homologação e implementação. Responsável organização das atividades dos demais desenvolvedores e também sob demanda codificar.

title: Senior Backend Developer - Java/Kotlin
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Java 8 (mínimo);

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Kotlin;

Definição de Arquitetura exercendo o papel de Referência Técnica;

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Spring (Boot, Data, Cache, etc);

Conhecimento em Filas (Rabbit);

Experiência em Filas (Kafka);

Experiência em AWS (SNS, SQS, S3);

Experiência em Git e Git-Flow;

Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL;

Desenvolvimento com foco em qualidade: testes unitários e Sonar(métricas);

Experiência em micro serviços e sistemas concorrentes;

Contínuos delivery (Jenkins);


A experiência de trabalhar na Invillia é única. E global. Temos o nosso próprio jeito de conectar talentos e construir inovações.

Revolucionamos o ambiente de trabalho #Instation + somos experts em desenvolver soluções complexas para #GameChangers + temos uma metodologia única #EngagedbyDataPeopleAction + investimos em pessoas #InvilliaAcademy

Alguns diferenciais Invillia:

_inovamos lado-a-lado com #GameChangersGlobais

_cultura de trabalho distribuído #inStation

_metodologia exclusiva #GlobalGrowthFramework

Faça uma imersão aqui


Então, se você busca uma oportunidade de trabalhar de onde estiver, em uma empresa dedicada em recriar a sensação de proximidade, de conexão humana, e de se sentir acolhido a qualquer momento, mesmo com todos distribuídos, aqui é o lugar certo.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
DESENVOLVEDOR JAVA BACKEND PLENO


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação; OU
  • Conclusão de qualquer curso de nível superior acompanhado de certificado de curso de pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia da Informação.


Obrigatório

  • Experiência exercendo atividades como desenvolvedores de aplicações Java EE 6+ com Springboot.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações para pelo menos um dos servidores:

* Apache Tomcat;

* JBoss/Wildfly;

* Open Liberty;

* WebSphere Application Server Liberty;

* WebSphere Application Server versão 8 ou superior.


  • Noções ou familiaridade com APIS REST
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e POO
  • Conhecimento de padrão de projeto, qualidade de código, boas práticas
  • Conhecimentos em SOLID
  • Conhecimentos em JPA


Desejável

  • Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.
  • Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou React.
  • Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas IBM DB2, MS SQL Server, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.

Informações adicionais:

Atuação remota

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.


Habilidades:


Habilidades Técnicas:


- GOOGLE CORE WEB VITALS

- LCP

- CLS

- TTFB

- GOOGLE LIGHTHOUSE

- DASHBOARDS DE PERFORMANCE

- DESIGN DE EXPERIENCIA DO USUARIO (UX/UI)

- HTML semântico

- CSS AVANCADO

- JAVASCRIPT MODERNO (ES6+)

- DESENVOLVEDOR REACT

- DESENVOLVIMENTO COM NEXT.JS

- Nuxt.js

- PWA (PROGRESSIVE WEB APPS)

- ADMINISTRACAO DA CLOUD AWS

- PROCESSAMENTO DE SITEMAPS

- DATADOG RUM (REAL USER MONITORING)


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Foco em resultados

- Resolução de problemas complexos

- COMUNICATIVO

- Adaptação e Aprendizado Contínuo

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid/Senior)
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. While we’re primarily seeking professionals comfortable working across the stack, from building Vue.js + TypeScript interfaces to developing Kotlin/Spring Boot APIs with PostgreSQL, we also welcome candidates with strong Frontend or Backend experience who are eager to collaborate in a full-stack environment.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement full-stack features and applications.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs using Kotlin/Spring Boot.
  • Build intuitive, responsive UIs with Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Work with PostgreSQL to design efficient schemas and queries.
  • Ensure high-quality code through testing (Playwright) and code reviews.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
  • Participate in system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you :

Mid-Level Engineers

  • Experience with Kotlin/Spring Boot for backend development.
  • Proficiency with Vue.js and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs and databases.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Good English communication skills.


Senior Engineers

  • Deep expertise across backend and frontend, able to design end-to-end systems.
  • Strong architectural knowledge focused on scalability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring peers and leading technical discussions.
  • Ability to balance priorities across the stack.
  • Good English communication skills.


Differential requirements:

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus or Grafana.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Brazil | SRE, Java & .NET Engineers (Remote)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Our mission is to be a meaningful part of our people's careers. As we grow, so does our determination to offer the best experience to our employees and clients — and that’s exactly what drives us. We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Óbidos, and representations in Brazil and Tunisia. We have over 12 years of market expertise, and today we are a universe of around 400 people working on-site, remotely or in hybrid mode in projects across 20+ countries.


We believe that great people make successful companies, and that’s why we stand for the appreciation, recognition and growth of our professionals.


We don’t want to be just another line on your CV — we want you to live a Lifetime Experience with us. We invest in training and certifications that confirm your real progression, in promoting a healthy work-life balance, and in offering benefits that impact your personal life and career.


#welcometoyourfuture



What we’re looking for:


Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

– 4 to 6 years of experience

– Strong knowledge in DevOps and Operations

– Experience with monitoring, CI/CD, cloud , and system reliability practices


⚙️ Java Engineer

– 4 to 6 years of experience in Java development

– Interest in learning new technologies , such as Python

– Experience with integration, APIs, testing, and troubleshooting

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!



What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
  • Standardize our ways of working across markets to improve timeliness and execution on furnishings and move-outs
  • Perform audits and improve data metrics for our guests and internal teams, as well as manage timely data collection to update productivity and achievements on projects
  • Unit/Building/Process information entry, ensuring all fields are accurately filled and clear for other teams
  • Collaborate with operational team members and organizational leaders to identify gaps and opportunities for process improvements
  • Communicate with third party vendors and companies if needed to support OPS/CX operations
  • Specific admin support related to onboarding and move-out of units for our US cities including:
  • Complete utility and telecommunication setups for new units with third party companies (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Complete Package Setups for new units (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Cancel utility and telecommunication accounts for move-outs
  • Support the scheduling of furnishing and onboarding tasks and move-outs:
  • Communicate with third party vendors and buildings to schedule pick ups
  • Input data into our system related to our properties
  • Track disposal and data related to move-outs
  • Support Central Operations, OPS local team, and finance/accounting with ad-hoc projects



What we are looking for:

  • Degree from a top-tier university
  • Min. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role (administrative experience in residential or hospitality experience will be considered as a plus)
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (formulation, data entry, charts, pivot tables) and Powerpoint
  • Self-starter with a roll up your sleeves mentality and high attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and focus on results
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with speed

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for ORACLE - Cloud FIN - TAX, Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Must-Have:

Broad experience in cloud implementations & support

Senior resources with hands-to-keyboard capabilities to configure Oracle Cloud TAX for Brazil localization

Oracle Cloud tax configuration, calculation, and management of required company registration numbers

Very good understanding of Brazil related localization in Oracle cloud


Good-to-Have

Able to work independently with customer

Agile way of working


Responsibility of / Expectations from the Role

Oracle Cloud Financial Modules – Support

Issue resolution and fix

Collaborate and meeting with users to understand the issue

Work with Oracle on Service request

Work with Global Support team located in India and collaborate for smooth issue resolution

Period close activities

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. title: Analista de Peoplesoft (Inglês fluente)
description:
#VAGA para Analista Senior de Sistemas PeopleSoft – Financials (AR/AP)

Remoto LATAM – Contractor (PJ) via Deel


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de Sistemas PeopleSoft sênior para atuar em projeto global de sistemas financeiros, contratado via Stefanini LATAM por meio da plataforma Deel (modelo PJ / contractor).

O trabalho é remoto, com base em LATAM, apoiando a área de Corporate Finance Technology de um grande cliente internacional. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui forte domínio técnico em PeopleSoft Financials (contas a receber e a pagar), extensões e integrações customizadas, e está habituado(a) a atuar em ambiente offshore/near-shore.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e executar o design técnico, desenvolvimento e manutenção dos módulos PeopleSoft Financials — especificamente Accounts Receivable (AR) e Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Criar, aprimorar e dar suporte a extensões, customizações e integrações em PeopleSoft utilizando PeopleTools, PeopleCode, Component Interface, Application Engine, SQR, Integration Broker
  • Colaborar com equipes de finanças e tecnologia globalmente para dar suporte aos processos de negócios financeiros, garantir integridade de dados, performance e alinhamento às necessidades do negócio
  • Diagnosticar, otimizar e dar suporte ao ambiente PeopleSoft ao longo do ciclo de vida do sistema
  • Produzir documentação técnica, participar de code reviews e garantir a aplicação de boas práticas e padrões


Requisitos

  • Experiência prática a nível sênior com PeopleSoft Financials (módulos AR/AP)
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e manutenção de extensões/customizações e integrações no PeopleSoft
  • Elevado nível técnico: PeopleTools, PeopleCode, Application Designer, Component Interface, Integration Broker, SQR, App Engine
  • Boa compreensão dos processos financeiros (AR, AP, fluxo de razão geral)
  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado) – capacidade de trabalhar com equipes baseadas nos EUA e globalmente

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote from Brazil)
description:
About Us

We’re a Boston-based real estate company seeking a detail-oriented accounting professional fluent in English to support our CFO with bookkeeping, financial reporting, and analysis. This remote role is based in Brazil and requires daily communication in English via Zoom and chat.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage QuickBooks invoices, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Categorize receipts and expenses; prepare monthly financial reports
  • Maintain spreadsheets for rental and mortgage tracking
  • Assist with budgets, financial models, and investor proposals
  • Provide accurate financial data and support the CFO on accounting projects
  • Manage compliance documentation by reviewing transaction files for accuracy and submitting documents for approval


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (or other accounting software and willingness to learn)
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets (or Excel and willingness to learn Google Sheets)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); all work and meetings are in English
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Reliable internet connection for Zoom and cloud systems
  • Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern (Boston time zone)


Compensation

  • Full-time, R$7,000/month
  • Remote from Brazil
  • Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (Boston HQ)


How to Apply

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

Applications that are not in English will not be reviewed...because the reviewer only speaks English. ;)
company: Santana Team - Keller Williams Boston NorthWest

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Case Manager (Project Manager)
description:
Job description


U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, case manager to join our team.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Communicate with client - Client communication and excellent customer service is key at the Law Office of Jacob Sapochnick
  • Serving as primary point of contact for clients , conducting initial meetings with clients, explain immigration process, requirements, providing regular updates on the case.
  • Document Collection - Review and analyze client documents. Assemble cases for filing, prepare and organize exhibits.
  • Ensure that clients understand the strategy and steps of the process and lead status updates calls with clients.
  • Be proactive and raising any issues that might delay the petition and report it to attorney and senior legal specialists.
  • Reviewing documentation provided by clients and make sure that client has been informed about all missing documents in advance.
  • Working closely with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand the strategy of the case and make sure it is implemented and making sure that the petition is ready in advance for the mid and final reviews of the attorney and that cases are submitted timely.



Requirements:

· Excellent communication skills, grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


· B.A. Degree in Law or English or related studies student or graduate.


· Previous legal or immigration experience preferred.


· High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


· Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


· Be comfortable with phone calls and video calls.


· Applicant must have the ability to use MS Excel, MS Outlook, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat Professional.


Compensation: $ - $ / monthly + regular bonuses


Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work or office work

Submit your CV, cover letter and writing sample at

Na Klooks, transformamos informações financeiras difíceis de acessar em dados claros, organizados e prontos para serem usados em decisões importantes. É por isso que algumas das maiores empresas do mundo, como Bloomberg, S&P e Moody’s, já confiam em nós. No Brasil, bancos como Itaú e Santander também utilizam nossos serviços, assim como centenas de consultorias que acessam todos os dias nossa plataforma.


Agora queremos escalar esse serviço — e precisamos de você para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Se você gosta de vendas consultivas, tem interesse por finanças e tecnologia, e se motiva em entender os desafios dos clientes para fechar negócios estratégicos, esse é o lugar certo para você crescer.


Perfil desejado – o que esperamos de você


Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil consultivo e analítico , que saiba

construir relações de confiança com os clientes e conduzir negociações de forma estratégica. É essencial ter escuta ativa, curiosidade para entender diferentes modelos de negócio e habilidade para traduzir dados e soluções técnicas em benefícios claros para o cliente.


Skills e competências que valorizamos

  • Experiência em vendas B2B , especialmente com ciclos consultivos e soluções complexas (SaaS, dados, tecnologia ou serviços financeiros);

  • Habilidade para entender o cenário do cliente , mapear dores e propor soluções alinhadas ao valor da Klooks;

title: Estagiário de Contas a Receber
description:
Atividades:

  • Prestar suporte nas alterações nas descrições das faturas a fim de atender as especificações normativas do cliente;
  • Realizar cancelamento da fatura de pessoa jurídica/física;
  • Apoiar no controle e cadastro das bolsas de descontos no sistema, visando atender os setores requisitantes na divulgação e captação de clientes;
  • Realizar o processo de Cobrança de clientes pessoa Jurídica;
  • Apoiar na análise financeira do aluno que solicitou transferência de turma ou matrícula com dispensa de disciplinas;
  • Gerar boleto para os alunos que contrataram o curso após o faturamento da turma já confirmada;


Requisitos e qualificações:

Escolaridade

  • Ensino Superior em andamento em: Administração, Processo Gerenciais, Gestão Financeira, Ciências Contábeis ou afins

Conhecimentos

  • Conhecimento em processos de faturamento e de cobrança
  • Conhecimento em legislação financeira
  • Excel intermediário


Benefícios:

Bolsa estágio;

Seguro de Vida;

Cartão multibenefícios (Alimentação + Refeição);

Day off de aniversário;

Wellhub by Gympass;

Auxílio home-office.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Joom Pulse is a data platform that provides analytics and recommendations for marketplace sellers. Its features allow you to review the most profitable products, know the estimated profit of buying directly from the supplier, discover the categories with the greatest growth potential, and explore profitable ways to expand your business. Joom Pulse helps make e-commerce data easy to understand and efficient for all sellers.


Joom Pulse is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international group of e-commerce companies that was founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom also includes the following businesses: Joom Marketplace, a platform for shopping from all over the world; Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany, and JoomPro, a platform for cross-border wholesale trade. Joom’s offices are located in Latvia, China, Hong Kong, the USA, Germany, Brazil, and Portugal. Joom Group has its HQ in Lisbon, Portugal.


We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success Specialist to foster strong client relationships, enhance user satisfaction, and support seamless product adoption and retention.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring alignment with customer needs
  • Provide fast & full answers to clients’ questions and support for their problems
  • Keep customers informed on new features and best practices to enhance usage
  • Monitor customer engagement and satisfaction to identify upsell and renewal opportunities
  • Lead renewal processes and identify growth opportunities within customer accounts
  • Ensure high retention rate by providing excellent customer success service & support


Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in customer success management
  • Fluency in Portuguese
  • Advanced communication skills with ability to handle difficult client conversations, build client trust and understand client perspectives
  • Ability to collect, structure, and filter clients’ feedback, and

title: Engenheiro de software JR
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Tibco Developer
description:
Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 5 years of experience with TIBCO BusinessWorks 5 and 6.
  • Strong knowledge of TIBCO BusinessWorks Container Edition (CE).
  • Experience with RESTful integrations and service-oriented architecture (SOA).
  • Strong command of XML, XSD, XPATH, and JDBC.
  • Experience integrating with AWS API Gateway.
  • Ability to analyze, design, and implement complex integration architectures.
  • Experience in migration or modernization projects for integration buses.
  • Previous participation in integration projects within large-scale corporate environments.
  • Fluent in Portuguese (B2+) – Mandatory .


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: remote from Brazil;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

    • The difference between something good and something great is attention to detail – AVM Consulting.

title: Contratação de Social Media com Habilidades de Design e Redação
description:
O objetivo é encontrar um profissional de social media que possua habilidades tanto em design quanto em redação. O trabalho envolve a criação de conteúdos visuais e textuais para redes sociais, exigindo criatividade, domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico e excelente comunicação escrita. O público-alvo são seguidores e potenciais clientes nas redes sociais. Espera-se que o profissional entregue posts atraentes, alinhados à estratégia da marca, e que compreenda tendências digitais para aumentar o engajamento.


Responsabilidades


Planejar e executar estratégias de conteúdo para redes sociais, alinhadas aos objetivos da marca e às tendências do mercado digital.


Criar posts, stories, vídeos curtos e anúncios, desenvolvendo tanto o conceito visual quanto o texto criativo de forma integrada.


Gerenciar o calendário editorial, garantindo consistência de comunicação e coerência entre campanhas, datas e temas relevantes.


Produzir artes e peças visuais utilizando ferramentas de design gráfico (como Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator ou similares), sempre seguindo o guia de identidade visual da marca.


Escrever legendas, roteiros e chamadas atrativas, com domínio da escrita criativa e foco em engajamento e conversão.


Monitorar métricas e interações, analisando resultados de campanhas e propondo melhorias contínuas com base em dados.


Interagir com a comunidade online, respondendo mensagens e comentários de forma empática, clara e dentro da voz da marca.


Colaborar com outras áreas (como marketing, performance, design e atendimento) para garantir integração e consistência nas entregas.


Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de redes sociais, comportamento do público e novas ferramentas de criação e análise.


Qualificações


Experiência prévia em gestão de redes sociais e criação de conteúdo (portfólio será considerado um diferencial).


Domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico, como Photoshop ou Figma.


Excelente escrita e criatividade, com capacidade de adaptar o tom de voz a diferentes plataformas e públicos.


Noções de fotografia, vídeo e edição básica, para criação de conteúdos ágeis e originais.


Conhecimento das principais métricas de engajamento, alcance e conversão em plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn e Facebook.


Capacidade de organização e autogestão, com atenção a prazos e detalhes.


Perfil colaborativo, proatividade e interesse genuíno em criar conteúdo relevante e de impacto.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno (GIS)
description:
Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react;
  • Conhecimentos em Python;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando todas as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics

title: Especialista em Parcerias Estratégicas
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Especialista em Parcerias para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, mapear e prospectar organizações estratégicas (empresas de grande porte, associações e sindicatos).
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias comerciais com potencial de gerar grande volume de usuários ou receita recorrente.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com BPOs que atendem empresas de grande porte para viabilizar contratos de alto impacto.
  • Representar a Jusfy em eventos estratégicos do setor jurídico, contábil e corporativo.
  • Acompanhar performance das parcerias e propor planos de expansão.


Experiência

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas, negócios corporativos ou vendas complexas (preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia).
  • Vivência em ambiente de crescimento e ritmo acelerado.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais a clientes/parceiros.


Diferencial

  • Experiência ou conhecimentos sobre o mercado jurídico.


Habilidades

  • Capacidade de negociação em alto nível e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de representação em eventos externos.


Ferramentas e dados

  • Experiência com CRM (preferencialmente Hubspot)


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, ownership e foco em solução de problemas
  • Curiosidade e sede por aprendizado contínuo
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados e crescimento


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Partnership Specialist e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga.

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno

Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)


Raise $100,000 EU  Earn 2,000 EU – Individuals | HNW | Small fund portfolios


Raise 5M EU  Earn 100,000 EU – UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios


Raise 10M EU  Earn 200,000 EU - UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 100M EU  Earn 2,000,000 EU - Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 1 Bill EU  Earn 20,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Raise 10 Bill EU  Earn 200,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Easy Next Step


Interested in joining the Magnum Equities Capital agent network?


Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:


Important Notes & Disclaimers


  • Magnum Equities does not require Capital Agents to hold securities licenses, as you are not directly soliciting or selling investment products. Only presenting partnership opportunity.
  • All commissions are distributed upon adequate clearing period.
  • All final post-placement due diligence, AML etc are handled internally by Magnum management.
  • This is a commission-only independent agent role. It is not an offer of employment, partnership, or representation, and no exclusivity or guarantees of earnings are provided.
  • Magnum Equities reserves the right to approve or reject capital partners at its sole discretion based on internal compliance protocols.

Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.

Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.

  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform

  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!

  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits

  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management

description:
Código da vaga: 54142


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento Full Stack
  • Forte atuação, principalmente no frontend com Angular (versão 9 ou superior) e TypeScript
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Java nas versões mais atuais para atuação no backend
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de backends com microserviços e APIs REST
  • Integração e atuação na construção de soluções web escaláveis
  • Domínio de práticas modernas de DevOps
